name: 92115 · San Diego, CA
findings: ZIP 92115 (San Diego) has 181 nonprofit organizations. 91 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 72 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92115 (San Diego) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 92115 (San Diego) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.2 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 12 organizations here; 19% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 14 social and fraternal organizations here list membership, compared with about 7 in similar places of this size.

observations.text: 24 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
